title: DRerio LogAI: an open-source, GPU-free platform for automated tracking and behavioural analysis of adult zebrafish (Danio rerio)

creators.name: Sant'Ana Camargos, Marco Antônio
creators.affiliation: São Paulo State University (UNESP), Botucatu, São Paulo, Brazil

creators.affiliation: São Paulo State University (UNESP), Botucatu, São Paulo, Brazil

description:
DRerio LogAI is an open-source desktop platform for automated tracking, closed-loop stimulation and behavioural analysis of adult zebrafish (Danio rerio). It combines YOLOv11 detection, BYTETracker multi-object tracking and Intel OpenVINO inference in an event-driven architecture, and runs GPU-free on integrated graphics.

This archive. Snapshot of the source code at tag v6.0.0, deposited as the citable code object for the associated manuscripts and the version those manuscripts cite. The analysis scripts and the paired coordinate tables that regenerate every reported statistic are deposited separately (see related identifiers).

Requirements. Python ≥ 3.12, < 3.15; Ultralytics YOLO ≥ 8.3.179; Intel OpenVINO ~2026.0; PyTorch ≥ 2.8; NumPy ~2.2; OpenCV ~4.13. Full dependency pins in pyproject.toml and poetry.lock. Validated on Windows 11; platform-independent Python otherwise.
